route.name: Damascus–Muzayrib (Damas–Hauran)
route.description: The 1,050 mm Damascus–Muzayrib line (Chemin de fer de Damas–Hauran), ~103 km, opened 1893/94 — the direct western route down the Hauran plain along the Hajj road, later absorbed into the Hejaz/CFH network and abandoned.
route.notes: PROVISIONAL identity (research report damascus-muzayrib-western-alignment.md; Daraa 24 + Wikipedia Mzerib). The western abandoned alignment ~6–11 km W of the Hejaz main line; the eastern Hejaz detour is the legal artefact of a French non-parallel clause. Opening 1893 (Arabic sources) vs inauguration 14 July 1894 — recorded as a source conflict. Status: abandoned (closure date not located; economic rationale collapsed by 1918 when Hauran grain shifted to Haifa). Station memberships are INFERRED (reconstructed from the Hajj-road corridor), not attested — do not present as settled. Northern terminus (Damascus via al-Kiswah/Khan Dannun, or al-Midan/Baramke/Qanawat) unresolved (Tier C, held). Muzayrib is a junction shared with haifa-deraa (our coord is exact; the report's is a ~2.6 km settlement proxy). Follow-ups (report §7): OSM changeset history + Mandate/GSGS sheets to upgrade to attested; possible H3 palimpsest with the abandoned 2000s SG Damascus–Sheikh Miskin–Daraa project → may need two route records sharing geometry.
